title: pomaderris flabellaris
intro: Pomaderris flabellaris, commonly known as Coastal Pomaderris, is a shrub native to the eastern coast of Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Pomaderris flabellaris include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which can aid in treating various skin conditions and infections. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
